t: This is the Lancaster Gate Memorial Cross, a grade two listed war memorial. It commemorates residents of the old Metropolitan Borough of Paddington who died fighting in the First World War. The cross carries depictions of a number of figures. Jesus Christ is shown here, along with Saint George, the soldier saint. Also shown are Saint Maurice, leader of the Theban Legion, Saint Florian, patron saint of firefighters, and Longinus, the Roman soldier who pierced the side of Jesus. King Louis the Ninth of France, who was made a saint, is depicted as well.
